{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness 的 Qwen-MM-Plugins 集成插件：12 个多模态 MCP 工具（视觉/OCR/定位/ASR/音视频）、Web 设置页（粘贴 Qwen API Key 即用）、内置技能与一键安装器","id":"gh:1333949538","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-qwen-mm-plugins","slug":"ShuiHan268/dsh-qwen-mm-plugins","topics":["asr","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","mcp","multimodal","plugin","qwen"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness 的 Qwen-MM-Plugins 集成插件：12 个多模态 MCP 工具（视觉/OCR/定位/ASR/音视频）、Web 设置页（粘贴 Qwen API Key 即用"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ness 的 Qwen-MM-Plugins 集成插件：12 个多模态 MCP 工具（视觉/OCR/定位/ASR/音视频）、Web 设置页（粘贴 Qwen API Key 即用）、内置技能与一键安装器"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-qwen-mm-plugins"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** · 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that brings the cloud multimodal capabilities of QwenLM/Qwen-MM-Pl"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"Harness (DSH) plugin that brings the cloud multimodal capabilities of QwenLM/Qwen-MM-Plugins to DSH."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **MCP tools** — 12 tools under `mcp__qwen-mm-plugins-api__*`: `vision_chat` (image understanding),"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" `ocr`, `grounding`, `transcribe_audio` (ASR), `omni_multi_speaker_asr` (speaker diarization), `omni"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"_av_caption` / `omni_av_grounding` (audio-video understanding), and more.
- **Bundled skill** — the "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"`qwen-mm-plugins-api` skill ships with the plugin; no manual `~/.dsh/skills` copying.
- **Settings p"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"age** — Web GUI → Settings → **Qwen 多模态**: paste a Qwen API Key and go. Keys live in the credential "},{"id":"p6s6","text":"store `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` (0600), never in session logs.
- **Live switch** — saving or rot"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"ating the key restarts the MCP child automatically; no DSH restart needed.
- **Capability management"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"** — all 8 capabilities (core / api / search / video-memory / video-edit / blender / freecad / edu-a"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"gent) with a 3-state model — **not installed → disabled → enabled** — plus one-click install/enable/"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"disable.
- **`/qwen-mm` command** — `status`, `verify`, `caps`, `install <cap>`, `disable <cap>`, `m"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"odel set <vl|omni> <id>`.
- **Model configuration** — the **Models** card on the settings page lets "},{"id":"p6s12","text":"you change the VL / Omni models anytime; saves take effect immediately, no DSH restart."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Quick Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Prerequisites: Node ≥ 18, a DeepSeek Harness installation, and either pnpm or Corepack."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The installer: bootstraps the `web` profile → installs `uv` if missing → builds the plugin venv from"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" the immutable tag → registers the plugin through the profile's pnpm layout (using Corepack when pnp"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"m is not directly available) → normalizes the YAML patch → runs a system self-check. Re-running repa"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"irs interrupted or legacy npm-based installs."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Open **Settings → Qwen 多模态**, paste your Qwen API Key, and save. A key in a legacy `~/.qwen-mm-plugi"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ns/config` is migrated automatically."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Options:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- `--install-source <dir-or-url>`: use a local checkout (or mirror URL) as the capability install so"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"urce.
- `--skip-venv`: skip venv creation; the plugin auto-provisions it on first boot.
- `DSH_HOME="},{"id":"p13s3","text":"<path>`: custom DSH home (default `~/.dsh`)."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Installing from the DeepSeek Harness plugin catalog"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"You can also skip `install.js` entirely: open the plugin catalog in the DeepSeek Harness GUI and, in"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" a conversation, ask the Agent to install this plugin — the Agent handles registration and configura"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"on, ask the Agent to install this plugin — the Agent handles registration and configuration for you."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Once capabilities are installed and enabled, **you don't select them manually** — just describe what"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" you want in plain language and attach files with `@`; the model calls the right tools for you."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Common examples:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| What you want | Just say |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Look at an image | `@photo.jpg what's in this image?` |
| Extract text | `extract the text from @s"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"can.png with OCR` |
| Transcribe audio | `transcribe @meeting.wav into timestamped subtitles` |
| Me"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"eting with speakers | `transcribe @meeting.mp4 with speaker labels` |
| Video highlights | `summariz"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"e @lecture.mp4 by timeline` |
| Read documents | `summarize page 3 of @report.pdf and extract the ta"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"bles` (needs core installed) |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Three things to remember:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"1. **No capability picker**: each enabled capability's tools are in the model's catalog; `api` works"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" out of the box once the Qwen API Key is saved.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Capability Management"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| State | Badge | Button |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Not installed | gray | [Install] |
| Disabled | yellow | [Enable] |
| Enabled | green | [Disable] "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"|
| Installing… | yellow | — |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- Install adds the capability's dependencies to the shared venv and mounts its MCP server; disable r"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"emoves the tools (dependencies stay) and can be re-enabled anytime.
- Dependency-level uninstall is "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"not offered: upstream ships one distribution with shared dependencies across capabilities, so per-ca"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"pability uninstall cannot be done safely.
- `edu-agent` is skill-only and not bundled here; `api` is"},{"id":"p26s5","text":" the core and cannot be disabled."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## UI Overview"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"After installing and configuring, open **Settings → Qwen 多模态** (in the left nav, alongside General, "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"Models, and the rest) — the page looks like this:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **Qwen API Key card**: paste the Qwen API Key from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio and click **保存** — i"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"t takes effect immediately. The dot on the top-right shows the state (green = configured, red = not "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"configured).
- **Capability card**: lists all 8 capabilities, each row with the capability name, a s"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"tate badge (not installed / disabled / enabled / installing…), and an action button (install / enabl"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"e / disable); missing system dependencies are called out (e.g. blender shows 「缺系统依赖：blender」 in the "},{"id":"p29s6","text":"screenshot).
- **Live status**: state refreshes right after a button click, and post-install depende"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"ncy probes sync to the page within seconds."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## How It Works"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- Keys go through the DSH credentials seam (`ctx.credentials`, ref `QMP_DASHSCOPE_API_KEY`); the pag"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"e uses the baked `api.credentials.{describe,set}` remotes — the official third-party path in rc.6, w"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"hose settings boundary is an explicit allowlist.
- Capability status is pushed via the `qwen-mm-caps"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"` session projection; actions run through the `/qwen-mm …` command channel, with status re-folding o"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"n the command lifecycle.
- The key is injected into MCP children via env vars; `credentials/updated`"},{"id":"p31s6","text":" re-spawns the child after a save."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Notes & Limitations"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- Media is preprocessed locally then uploaded to DashScope — do not use with sensitive content.
- `g"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"itTag` defaults to `qwen-mm-plugins-api-v1.0.3`; bump it to follow upstream releases."}],"truncated":true}
